NBABase: Steve Kerr suggests he, Steph Curry, and Draymond Green could all leave the Warriors together: "I signed for two years and I can't see myself walking away after this year, but it feels now like there's some shape to this thing. There's some clarity. I could see this ending where Steph, Dray, we all leave around the same time. I could see that happening." (Via @loganmmurdock)
